<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **19** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/18.ui__ViewItemWire__columnState.ts`, `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/18.ui__ViewMetadata__columnState.ts`, `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**8** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`  _(via crm_case (literal, a string literal in fixture))_
- `content/docs/automation/queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx`  _(via crm_case (literal, a string literal in fixture))_
- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/meta/view/:name (route, a path literal in surface))_
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via crm_case (literal, a string literal in fixture))_
- `content/docs/deployment/seed-tenancy-repair.mdx`  _(via crm_case (literal, a string literal in fixture))_
- `content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/meta/view/:name (route, a path literal in surface))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/index.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/meta/view/:name (route, a path literal in surface))_
- `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/meta/view/:name (route, a path literal in surface))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via retiredAfter (symbol, a field of const object viewColumnStateRemoved), retiredFromLoadPath (symbol, a field of const object viewColumnStateRemoved))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/meta/view/:name (route, a path literal in surface))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/18.ui__ViewItemWire__columnState.ts`, `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/18.ui__ViewMetadata__columnState.ts`, `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **9** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **68** of **250** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **174** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6a35635a3385d74859186c271b306da0c999e6a7` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `98c986531dc63b67d1bac296242d5815376c4821` — the merge of head `2fff67a6d15a13ef6cc19d408d2399ae994ed60b` into base `6a35635a3385d74859186c271b306da0c999e6a7`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 98c986531dc63b67d1bac296242d5815376c4821 && git checkout 98c986531dc63b67d1bac296242d5815376c4821
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 6a35635a3385d74859186c271b306da0c999e6a7 2fff67a6d15a13ef6cc19d408d2399ae994ed60b && git checkout -B drift-repro 6a35635a3385d74859186c271b306da0c999e6a7 && git merge --no-ff 2fff67a6d15a13ef6cc19d408d2399ae994ed60b

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6a35635a3385d74859186c271b306da0c999e6a7
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 6a35635a3385d74859186c271b306da0c999e6a7` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

L1 REWORK · head `94e3b6a84f3bff59251ed680a59740be3eb3b2b4` · 2026-11-22T12:13Z

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:列表用户感觉不到。视图上残留的「个人列布局」字段 `columnState` 从规范里退掉了:再保存带这个字段的视图,会被明确拒绝并提示怎么改;已存的视图读出时会自动去掉它。
- 为什么做:卡 #36403。这是「列表改动先是草稿、列宽只记在浏览器里」那张卡剩下的规范一半:这个字段已经没有地方写入了。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是,只存了列布局、别的什么都没有的个人覆盖行会变成无效行,要手动删掉(changeset 写明了)。可以整体撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。
- 席位意见:REWORK,共 2 项,都只改 PR 正文或立一张卡,不动代码。退役套件、声明和 dogfood 我读下来都是对的,见下面。

## 要改的(2 项)

1. **PR 正文缺 `Skills-docs:` 一行。** 种类是 `narrowed`,又带 `(narrowing)` 分支,所以要有这一行,缺了就判 REWORK;`l1-face` 也标了。正文写「zero hits, so no `Skills-docs:` line is owed」,但规定是:没有要改的,也要写一行 `none — 理由`,不是不写(同 #36357)。我在 head 上 `git grep` 过 `skills/`,`columnState` 一处也没有,所以写 `Skills-docs: none — skills/** never names columnState (git grep at the head)` 就属实。只加在 PR 正文。
2. **`objectViewListRenderer.tsx:787` 那一级回退,要有一张已经立好的卡来接。** 席位问它该不该进本 PR。我的判断:不必进本 PR,但现在写的「carrier: seat 7」不够,要立卡,正文写上卡号 `#N`。理由:
   - 不进本 PR 是成立的。AGENTS.md Post-Task 第 4 步只要求「会弄坏 `ui/` 的删除」把 `ui/` 的修复一起带上。这一级回退读的是 `(viewDef as any).columnState ?? (listSchema as any).columnState`,本 PR 之后两边都读到 `undefined`,`Type Check UI` 是绿的,没有坏掉什么。同一个文件里还有 #36370 在改,一起改只会多一处冲突。卡是 `domain:spec`,而这是 `ui/` 的清理。
   - 但必须有卡。按 L1 清单,范围外的东西要有去处;「follow-up owed」也是立了卡、改成 `#N` 才算(同 #36399 的先例)。而且这条回退藏在 `as any` 后面,没有任何门禁会再把它找出来。
   - 那张卡请一并带上同一件事在 `ui/` 里剩下的部分,都是本 PR 之后不再成立的文字或读取,我在 head 上 grep 到的有:`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts:3349`,`VIEW_OVERLAY_OWNED_KEYS` 里的 `'columnState'`,以及它上面 3301 和 3328 两段把它当作活键来讲的注释;`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewTabs.ts:502`,「`columnState`, the runtime-only key」。`plugin-grid` 和 `personalViews.ts` 里的 `columnState` 是 grid 的运行时属性和用户偏好,不是这个视图键,不在其内。

## 席位核对

- 形态:draft、base `main`、`Fixes #36403`;23 个文件,改动 652 行。`Fixes` 能成立:卡要的是规范这一半,也就是退掉视图行上的这个键,本 PR 交付的就是这个。
- `l1-face` 标的 changeset:`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 和 `@object-ui/data-objectstack` 各只改了一个测试文件(`protocol.graft-folded-form-sections.test.ts`、`listViews.roundTripKeys-11013.test.ts`),两个包的 `files` 都只发布 dist,所以不欠条目。`VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS` 少了一个键,这两个包是在运行时从 spec 读这个列表的,它们自己的 dist 不变,也不欠。`@objectstack/spec` 是 `minor`,有 BREAKING 标注、FROM → TO 和修复方法。
- 声明:`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` 属实,只有收窄,没有放宽:两个新的提示常量 `VIEW_COLUMN_STATE_RETIRED` 和 `VIEW_LIST_COLUMN_STATE_RETIRED` 都没有导出;删掉的 `ViewColumnStateSchema` 本来就不导出;`VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS` 从 6 个键变成 5 个,只是收窄。`Metadata-protocol: narrowed` 属实;changeset 里有 `<!-- adr-0087: registered view-column-state-retired -->`,`check:adr-0087-registration` 已过。
- 退役套件(按 `spec-property-retirement` 逐面核):
  - 墓碑:`retiredKey()` 墓碑挂在 `viewItemWireFields()` 和 `flattenedViewOverlayFields()` 上,覆盖 `view` union 的第 1、3、4 个成员。
  - 写作入口:原来就会按名字拒绝,现在改用退役说明。列表视图正文用的是不带迁移命令的那一版说明,因为没有 conversion 会走到列表视图正文,这个区分是对的。
  - 迁移:D2 conversion `view-column-state-removed` 在 `views` 和 `viewItems` 里都只删记录和打平覆盖行上的这个键,不动容器;D3 条目;`RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` 两行;STEP18 理由。
  - 文档与台账:生成的 `view.mdx`;严格度台账重新生成;`retired-key-removal-version` 的 JOIN 一行。
  - 「只剩身份字段的覆盖行」这一类,changeset 和 D3 都写明了处理方式(读出时标为无效,用 `--apply` 会报告 failed,删掉即可)。它就是本 PR 唯一带进来的不兼容,写得够清楚。
  - 正文说 `authorable-surface/`、`json-schema.manifest/`、`api-surface/` 逐字节不变,理由和 `owner` / `hidden` 退役时一样,我照收。
- dogfood:欠全量(标题带 `!`,还有 `(narrowing)` 分支)。正文钉在本 head `94e3b6a8` 上:485 个文件通过、3 个跳过,4108 条通过、68 条跳过,0 失败,所以钉到了 head。第 1、2 项只改正文,head 不会动,这个钉子在落地时仍然有效。
- 文本逐句核:changeset 的 FROM → TO 四条、修复方法、`--from 17` 和 `--stored --apply` 两个命令、身份字段那一类,都与 diff 和两段退役说明一致。`view.mdx` 的两行和 describe 一致。
- CI @ `94e3b6a8`:63 success · 11 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending;mergeable_state clean。
- 落地条款:非受管的收窄,改动 875 行。两项改完后我做增量 L1,只核正文那一行和卡号;再加上契约档 L2 PASS,按先例由席位用 `--land` 落地(dogfood 已经钉到 head)。

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `94e3b6a84f3bff59251ed680a59740be3eb3b2b4`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/18/view-column-state-removed.ts, packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/18.ui__ViewItemWire__columnState.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/18.ui__ViewMetadata__columnState.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.view-column-state-retired.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template, packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts + none

Read for this record: card #36403 with its three comments, PR #36435 body, file list and net diff against `main` (merge base `97b9d1e6`), and the check-runs on the head. Code outside the diff was read, not reviewed: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx`, `listDraftStore.ts`, `objectViewTabs.ts`, `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`, the two `owner` / `hidden` precedent conversions, `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`, `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`. Nothing was built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set, view item record (`viewItemWireFields()`): `columnState` goes from an accepted optional object to a `retiredKey()` tombstone. Narrowing. Named right by the dev.
- Accept set, flattened list and form overlays (`flattenedViewOverlayFields()`): same change. Narrowing. Named right.
- Authoring doors (`VIEW_ITEM_SURFACE.guidance`, `ListViewShapeSchema.guidance`): the key was refused before and is refused now. Only the message changes. No accept-set change. Named right.
- `VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS`: a published const loses one key, six to five. The export stays. Its `as const` type narrows, so a consumer that indexes `.columnState` stops compiling. The changeset names this line. The body sentence "no published export is removed" is true as written.
- `ViewColumnStateSchema`: module-private, deleted. No public surface.
- The narrowing arm names what stops being accepted: `columnState` on a view item record and on a flattened view overlay. That is exactly the two tombstone sites in the diff. No other key or value is narrowed.
- Stored rows: the D2 strip changes what a stored row is served as. One class, the column-state-only overlay with no `_isOverride` marker, moves from badged valid to badged invalid. The dev names that class in the D2 docblock, the D3 entry and the changeset. A second effect is not named right. See M1.
- Generated baselines: `view.mdx` regenerated. `authorable-surface`, `json-schema.manifest` and `api-surface` carry no diff. `Spec property liveness`, `Lint · docs & code guards` and `Build Core` are green on the head, so the gates agree.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/36403-view-column-state-retired.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor. `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` takes at least minor on the package the diff moves (AGENTS.md, changeset rule). Correct. A major is not allowed and none is claimed.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`: correct. The clause asks whether the card widens the accept set or the public surface. It does neither. The `(narrowing)` arm is owed and present, in the PR body and in the changeset body. The card and the claim comment wrote `yes (narrowing)`. The claim said the thread re-judges the arm from the diff, and the re-judged value is the right one.
- BREAKING banner, FROM and TO lines, the one-line fix and one ADR-0087 marker (`registered view-column-state-retired`) are all in the changeset. `Check Changeset` is green twice on the head.
- `retiredAfter: '18.6.0'` with "removed in 18.7.0" in the prescription: `packages/spec/package.json` is at 18.6.0 and the bump is minor, so the two agree.
- Dogfood battery: the PR body pins the full battery to this head (`94e3b6a8`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`, 485 files passed, 3 skipped, 4108 tests passed). The CI dogfood shards are skipped on a PR run, so the body line is the only battery evidence and it is on the reviewed head. Not re-run here.
- Governance: `check-governed-merges.mjs` reads paths and size. No path in this PR is on its register (`packages/spec/src/**` is clear, `docs/adr/**` is untouched) and 875 changed lines is under the 3000 threshold. So the path predicate answers not governed. The declaration decides instead: the fifth leg of `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (card #35321) reads `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` and the `(narrowing)` arm and refuses the queued PR until both halves exist, an authorized approved review or the maintainer's own enqueue, and a PASS record on the current head at this tier. This PR is governed by that leg. A seat must not arm it on a record alone. This record is a FAIL, so neither half exists yet.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty in the os-dev-report. One question should have been raised and is raised here. See M1 and the premise flag below.
- Premise flag. The card says "A key no reader writes or reads" and its step 1 says "Confirm none is live". The report says `premise_still_valid: true`. The writer half holds. The reader half does not hold at the merge base. Escalated to the seat with M1.
- Dev flag, class b: the fallback rung at `objectViewListRenderer.tsx:787`, "dead fallback, noted, not filed". Answer: it is not a dead rung at `main`. It is the reader M1 turns on. It becomes dead only because the D2 strip removes its input. The follow-up is real and has no card. The seat should file it, and it should also carry the hand-written `columnState` entry in `VIEW_OVERLAY_OWNED_KEYS` and the two comments that still say the spec declares the key (`objectViewTabs.ts` near line 502, `data-objectstack/src/index.ts` near line 6502). The file fence for #36370 is a fair reason not to edit the renderer in this PR.
- Dev flag, class c: `docs/adr/0005` line 388 names the key in a dated reading. Left as written. Accepted. The line dates itself and `docs/adr/**` is Tier H.
- Rulings cited but not on this card. The D2 docblock, the D3 entry, `view.zod.ts` and the PR body quote a maintainer ruling on #35955 that a stored layout is not carried forward. Card #36403 carries no ruling comment. Its body only says the server-side personal list preference retires. This record could not verify the quoted ruling from its inputs. The seat should link or restate the ruling on this card before the delta review.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join.
- Liveness ledger, no row owed: accepted. `Spec property liveness` is green on the head and the `owner` / `hidden` precedent had none.
- No tree-scoped absence pin: accepted. The bare name stays live as a grid prop and a preference field, so such a pin could not tell the two apart.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`. The two tombstones sit on the two members that declared the key, and the authoring doors keep their refusal by name. The prescription text is one constant with a fix an author can follow. The list view body gets its own text with no migration command, which is right because no conversion reaches that body. `ViewColumnStateSchema` had no other reader. The TDZ note above the constant still holds for a string constant. Holds, apart from the sentence M1 covers.

`packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/18/view-column-state-removed.ts`. The discriminator is the union of the two precedent entries: a record needs `viewKind` list or form and a `config` object, an overlay has no `config` and no container slot, a container is left alone. A row with a non-object `config` or another `viewKind` is not stripped, and the door refuses it with the tombstone text, which is the safe side. The strip is idempotent. Both collections are covered. The fixture shows all five row shapes and three notices. The mechanics hold. Its account of the effect does not. See M1.

`packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`. Import and row are placed in identifier order. Order 83 is one above the highest (82) and unique. No other step-18 conversion reads `columnState`, so the position cannot change another conversion's result. Holds.

`18.ui__ViewItemWire__columnState.ts` and `18.ui__ViewMetadata__columnState.ts`. The keys match the precedent rows for `owner`. Each says plainly that no gate judges it and why. Holds.

`18.view-column-state-retired.ts` (D3). One entry for one family is right. The acceptance criteria state the two stored classes and the remedy for the residue. The `reason` field is wrong on the main point. See M1.

`registry.ts.template`. The fragment's order 123 is unique and follows 122. Its text says no writer is left and describes the strip and the residue. It makes no claim about readers. Holds.

M1 (must-fix) — the D2 and D3 entries say the strip changes nothing a reader sees, and the tree says it does. At the merge base and at this head, a stored `columnState` is read and applied. A record's key rides `listViews()` through `VIEW_ITEM_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS` (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`). An overlay's key survives `narrowPersonalizationOverlay` through `VIEW_OVERLAY_OWNED_KEYS`. Both reach `objectViewListRenderer.tsx:787`, which hands `viewDef.columnState` to the grid whenever `listDraftPreference` returns no column state, that is for any reader with no draft order and no widths in this browser. `ListView.tsx` passes it on and `objectGridColumnState.ts` seeds the grid from it. So before this PR such a reader sees the stored column order and widths, and after it sees the view's own. That is a visible change to stored documents, not a lossless delete. Three sentences in `hits` files deny it: the D2 docblock ("it changes no render: no reader applies a stored column layout any more"), the D3 `reason` ("The delete is lossless for what anyone sees" and "no reader applies it any more"), and the D2 `summary` ("nothing writes or reads it"). The changeset does say a stored layout is not carried forward, so the PR contradicts itself, and the D3 record is the one an upgrading operator is told to trust. The D3 acceptance criteria also give the operator nothing to check for this change. Fix, one of two. Either state the loss in the D2 docblock, the D3 `reason` and acceptance criteria, and the prescription, with the #35955 ruling linked on this card as its authority. Or carry a stored `order` into `fieldOrder` where the view sets none and say only the widths are dropped. The choice is the maintainer's or the seat's, not the reviewer's.

S1 (should-fix) — the ADR-0049 basis is stated as a census result the census did not return. `view.zod.ts` says "The console's readers that still named the key read rows at rest, and the D2 conversion strips the key from those on every read", which admits the reader in the same docblock that calls the key unread, and `VIEW_COLUMN_STATE_RETIRED` tells an author "nothing writes or reads it any more". Reword both so the published text says no writer is left and the stored layout is no longer applied from this release, and correct the changeset sentence "Since #35955 nothing writes or reads it" to match.
